statement: The work is a painting rather than a diagram.
visual evidence / reason: A continuous representational painted scene; no diagrammatic schema.

statement: Every part has Rāhu quality and no other quality.
visual evidence / reason: Exclusive symbolic quality cannot be established visually.

statement: It holds no word, letter, numeral, or glyph.
visual evidence / reason: No writing or glyphs are visible.

statement: Both readings of paired correspondences are present.
visual evidence / reason: The meta-claim is not independently testable from the pixels.

statement: The sun is being swallowed in total eclipse.
visual evidence / reason: A black circular sun with bright corona is directly approached by the giant open mouth.

statement: The eclipse occurs at midday.
visual evidence / reason: Totality darkens the scene and no independent clock or solar altitude fixes midday.

statement: Eclipse stands over southwest.
visual evidence / reason: No compass cue establishes southwest.

statement: Land beneath has gone dark.
visual evidence / reason: Terrain and figures lie in deep eclipse shadow.

statement: Imposing figure rises from dark, made of smoke, blue-bodied with dark-blue gleam.
visual evidence / reason: A monumental blue-black torso coalesces from smoke and clouds.

statement: Head tilted up, mouth open toward sun, taking it in.
visual evidence / reason: Face turns upward with open mouth immediately beneath the eclipsed disc.

statement: Eyes bright and knowing; rest of face masked by smoke.
visual evidence / reason: One eye shines sharply while smoke obscures much of the face.

statement: Old patchwork cloth of many colours.
visual evidence / reason: Tattered multicolour strips drape the shoulders and torso.

statement: Ravines and caves.
visual evidence / reason: Jagged gullies and several dark cave mouths fill the lower slopes.

statement: Dark snake hole in anthill.
visual evidence / reason: A perforated earthen mound with a black opening stands at bottom centre.

statement: Thicket and forest climbing to mountain summit.
visual evidence / reason: Dense scrub/trees climb the right-hand mountain ridge.

statement: Spy watches behind a rock.
visual evidence / reason: A concealed human face peers from behind rock at lower left.

statement: Thief carries something off.
visual evidence / reason: A crouching runner clutches a round vessel or bundle.

statement: A wrestler.
visual evidence / reason: A muscular kneeling figure grapples/strains at centre.

statement: Snake catcher with serpent.
visual evidence / reason: A seated man faces and handles an upright cobra.

statement: Army far away.
visual evidence / reason: A distant marching formation with flags lines the right ridge.

statement: Serpent, owl, wolf, donkey and camel.
visual evidence / reason: All five animals appear distinctly in the lower half.

statement: Small biting creatures.
visual evidence / reason: Ant/scorpion-like insects crawl across the foreground.

statement: Black gram and sesame.
visual evidence / reason: Black and pale seed/bean piles are shown, but species cannot be authenticated visually.

statement: Lump of lead and honey-coloured stone.
visual evidence / reason: A grey metallic-looking rock and glowing amber stone appear; material identity is not visually provable.

statement: Tall, top-heavy canvas; dark mass thickens upward and draws forms to eclipse.
visual evidence / reason: Portrait canvas concentrates giant smoky body and eclipse in its upper half with upward flow.

statement: Only light is eclipse ring and cold gleam on figure.
visual evidence / reason: A distinctly warm self-luminous amber stone glows at bottom right in addition to the corona and blue gleam.

statement: Everything else is guessed at.
visual evidence / reason: Many lower figures, animals, seeds, and rocks are rendered with clear, legible detail rather than merely guessed forms.

statement: No drawn outline anywhere; forms melt into one another.
visual evidence / reason: Edges arise through tonal modelling rather than drawn contour lines, while smoke merges figure, terrain, and cloud.

statement: Layered dark glaze; things seem one creature then another.
visual evidence / reason: Smoke transitions into face, torso, mountain, and animal-like cloud forms ambiguously.

statement: Blue-black, smoke grey, deep blue, pale eclipse ring, multicolour flecks.
visual evidence / reason: The stated palette is visibly dominant and patchwork provides coloured flecks.

statement: Malefic figure associated with southwest and touch.
visual evidence / reason: Threatening presentation is visible; astrological status, direction, and touch association are not.

statement: Orbital crossing and eclipse geometry.
visual evidence / reason: An eclipse is pictured; orbital latitude geometry and lunar phase/crossing cannot be derived from the scene.

statement: Sun is swallowed in eclipse myth.
visual evidence / reason: The giant smoky mouth visibly reaches to consume the blackened sun.

statement: Point of intake / receiving solar or lunar power.
visual evidence / reason: The swallowing gesture supports intake metaphor, but the two doctrinal readings cannot be visually distinguished.

statement: Fearsome and tending toward false speech.
visual evidence / reason: The figure is fearsome; truthfulness cannot be assessed visually.

statement: Turns toward acquiring resources and building faculties.
visual evidence / reason: No visible action establishes this abstract developmental orientation.

statement: Intelligent/lacking intelligence/cunning portraits.
visual evidence / reason: A bright eye can suggest alertness; cognition and cunning cannot be determined.

statement: Moon at bends/crossings changes human adaptability, activity, and mind.
visual evidence / reason: No Moon or mental-state comparison is visually available.

statement: Imposing stature and windy constitution.
visual evidence / reason: The giant scale and smoke/wind-blown dissolution visibly embody both cues.

statement: Spy, thief, wrestler, snake catcher and army.
visual evidence / reason: Each occupational/role motif is explicitly represented.

statement: Old cloth and many-coloured patchwork garment.
visual evidence / reason: Torn variegated drapery is conspicuous.

statement: Anthill, snake hole, caves, ravines, summit and forest.
visual evidence / reason: All listed landforms/sites are visible.

statement: Donkey, serpent, ram, wolf, camel, owl, small biting creatures.
visual evidence / reason: All named animals are present; the ram is low near centre-left.

statement: Black gram, sesame and thickets.
visual evidence / reason: Seed piles and thicket are visible; precise seed species are undecidable.

statement: Lead as metal.
visual evidence / reason: Grey rock may symbolize lead but material cannot be confirmed visually.

statement: Named gomedha stone, agate or retained name.
visual evidence / reason: Honey-coloured stone is shown, but species/name cannot be inferred from appearance.

statement: Dark/blue gleam, blue body and smoky appearance are separate features.
visual evidence / reason: Blue body surfaces glimmer while smoky edges and clouds remain materially distinct.

statement: Skin disease and hiccups.
visual evidence / reason: No reliable sign of either condition is visible.

statement: Approaching alignment can intensify posture/movement disorders.
visual evidence / reason: The astrological configuration and medical effect are not visually represented.

statement: Visible addition: a ram among the lower animals.
visual evidence / reason: A curled-horn ram is visible although the explicit painting inventory at L12 omits it; correspondence L58 includes it.

statement: Visible addition: warm glowing amber stone emits its own light.
visual evidence / reason: The lower-right stone has a bright orange core and halo beyond the stated two light sources.

statement: Visible addition: pale/white seed pile beside black gram.
visual evidence / reason: A clearly separate pale seed pile is rendered at the bottom edge.
